title: Ability composition (abilities/*.json, format v2)
description: One usable ability as a format-v2 composition: id/name/usage (plain fields — spec 2026-07-25-format-v2-composition-design.md §3: "usage stays a plain ability field") plus a compose list of atom refs + param bindings, flattened into a CompiledPower at load (internal/rules/load.go's loadCompositions + internal/rules/compile.go). This document is the external contract for ruleset authors and is cross-checked against loader behavior by internal/rules/schema_test.go.

usage.description: Either the bare string "at_will", or an object spending a declared resource.

compose.description: The ordered list of atom refs + param bindings this ability composes (spec §4). Execution order is derived from the atoms' declared provides/consumes graph, NOT this list's order — list order breaks ties deterministically (and, where tied same-branch outcomes touch the same clamped resource, meaningfully; spec §4).

atom.description: An atom id declared under atoms/.

bind.description: param name -> bound value: an integer for an int-kind param, a string (an expression) for an expr-kind param, or a string (a declared name) for an attribute/resource/defense/condition-kind param. Must bind every param the referenced atom declares, and no others (atom.schema.json's params list).
